questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests mastery of advanced lock-free data structures, NUMA-aware memory placement, and cross-socket contention. It also probes practical design choices for zero-copy paths in high-throughput RPC.

## Key Concepts

- NUMA-aware memory placement and huge pages
- Lock-free queue with ABA avoidance via version counters
- Credit-based flow control and backpressure
- Memory ordering (acquire/release) and cache-line alignment
- Cross-socket latency benchmarking

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudo-code: enqueue
slot = (tail + 1) % N
if (credits[producer] > 0) {
  slots[slot].data = payload
  slots[slot].version = slots[slot].version + 1
  atomic_store(tail, slot, memory_order_release)
  atomic_fetch_add(&credits[producer], -1, memory_order_relaxed)
}
```

```javascript
// Pseudo-code: dequeue
slot = head
if (slots[slot].data != NULL) {
  payload = slots[slot].data
  slots[slot].data = NULL
  atomic_fetch_add(&head, 1, memory_order_release)
  atomic_fetch_add(&credits[consumer], 1, memory_order_relaxed)
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you validate correctness under cacheline false sharing?
- How would you adapt the design for more than two NUMA nodes?
